assessments.evidence: The current Premier aggregate Triage and Response row lists Cloud Platform 10.2.x+ and ES 8.6+, while the 8.8 task guide lists ES 8.7+ with paired SOAR. The 8.7 task guide retains historical AI SOC analyst naming. Earlier explicit Essentials Triage wording is historical and the current aggregate row does not decide subcomponent entitlement. CMP setup separately requires Platform 10.4+, ES 8.8+, Cloud Connect 2.0+ and SAIA 2.4+. The Cloud Connected installation guide still plans 2.4.0 and excludes 2.2.0–2.3.6. Current task constraints retain existing triaged findings, first ten findings, approximately 200 findings per tenant per day, frontier models, connector and investigation permissions and granular SOAR asset roles. ES GA does not change those conditions. Region/authorization, exact pairing and per-agent entitlement remain excluded.
